narr: During the early to late evening hours on the 4th of June severe thunderstorms moved through the southwest to south central Texas Panhandle. The main supercell that moved in first from eastern New Mexico, quickly intensified in Deaf Smith County, where it briefly produced a weak tornado that overturned a couple of irrigation pivots. The storm then continued to produce ping pong ball to even an instance of baseball size hail as it moved into Randall County.
ev: Heavy rain occurred in Palo Duro Canyon, which resulted in flash flooding. The flooding closed a portion of the main road going through the canyon.
lsr: Park Ranger reported flooding occurred in Palo Duro Canyon which has closed a portion of the main road going through the canyon.
